critical.title: ⚡ STRUCTURAL — Binance hack update: North Korea attribution, restart timeline
critical.text: TRM Labs and Chainalysis attribute the ~$6.3B drain to North Korea's TraderTraitor group (linked to September's Bitget breach). About $3B is frozen; attackers converted $325M of stablecoins into ~$285M of ETH to avoid freezes. Binance reserved $6.34B of its own funds, is buying back tokens via market and OTC, and targets a phased withdrawal restart on Sunday 11/01 with proof of reserves on Monday 11/02. Lens impact: 🔴 Adoption/Reserve unchanged; restart and reserves proof are the next resolution events.

critical.title: ⚡ ANALYST SIGNAL CHANGE — Villaverde cycle timeline (10/30)
critical.text: Villaverde (Weiss, 10/30) says BTC appears to have bottomed 10/15 near $80K but the low is not official; he expects the current 80-day cycle low between now and ~11/13, needs a close above $85K to confirm, and expects another low (possible 320-day cycle low) 12/24–01/13. The 10/23 $95K year-end target was not restated. Lens impact: 🟢 held; timeline now explicit.
